effect_description_eng: [On Play] Reveal the top 3 cards of your deck. Add 1 card with [Knightmon] in its text and 1 card with [Knightmon] in its name among them to the hand. Return the rest to the bottom of the deck.
inherited_effect_description_eng: [All Turns] [Once Per Turn] When this Digimon would leave the battle area other than by your effects, by deleting 1 of your other Digimon with [Knightmon] in its text, it doesn't leave.
